about.title1: A brand built on material, time,
about.storyP1: MAAN was founded on a belief in 'slow furniture' — in an age of fast consumption, we chose to spend longer refining every piece, so furniture becomes a companion for decades rather than a seasonal purchase.
about.storyP2: The brand name '漫家居' (MAAN) comes from the image 'a house has ten thousand corners, and light lives in every one' — a home is made of countless corners, edges and details, and we believe only by weighing proportion and material from a thousand angles can every corner be treated with care. We fuse Nordic minimalist craft tradition with the relaxed aesthetic of Australian coastal living, developing a furniture language for the contemporary Asian home.
about.storyP3: Today, MAAN continues to collaborate with designers from Denmark, France and Japan, while developing a new generation of sustainable materials together with local Taiwanese workshops — hoping to redefine 'made to last' as a way of living anyone can practise.
about.philosophyTitle2: we design the everyday, treated gently by time
about.philosophyIntro: At MAAN, design is a series of trade-offs — form against function, character against restraint, the trend of the moment against staying power over years. Here are the three principles behind every decision we make.

principles.title: Material Before Form
principles.body: We believe good design begins with the character of the material itself. Every proposal starts with the feel of a piece of timber or a roll of leather — never with a sketch.

principles.title: Proportion Is the Invisible Ornament
principles.body: With no elaborate carving or excess line, MAAN adjusts proportion down to the millimetre so every piece sits exactly right in a room — which we consider the highest form of decoration.

principles.title: Designed for Use, Not for Display
principles.body: Furniture should be remembered by the body before it's remembered by the eye. Every seat angle and table height is tested against real, lived-in scenarios, over and over.

about.quoteLine1: "The end goal of design is not to be seen,
about.quoteLine2: but to be forgotten by the person using it — because it has already become part of life."

milestones.text: Our founders begin hand experiments in solid-wood furniture across studios in Copenhagen and Melbourne.
MAAN's first studio opens in Taipei, beginning long-term partnerships with European workshops.
The first complete product line launches, alongside a set of sustainable sourcing standards.
A custom collaboration programme with independent designers begins; pieces are placed in over a dozen homes and commercial spaces.
Continued investment in material research, working toward becoming one of Asia's leading contemporary luxury furniture brands.

values.title: Honest Material
values.text: No disguise, no over-processing — letting grain, leather and fabric show their true character.

values.title: Restrained Design
values.text: No excess ornament — proportion and negative space define how a room breathes.

values.title: Lasting Craft
values.text: Every piece is designed on the assumption of at least a decade of daily use.

values.title: Local & Sustainable
values.text: Sustainably certified materials come first, alongside support for local workshop craft.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.description: Whether it's a product question, an in-home measurement, or a custom proposal, our advisory team is glad to help.

faqs.q: Do you offer in-home measurement and planning?
faqs.a: Yes — any client who books a consultation can arrange for a design consultant to measure on site and advise on furniture layout.

faqs.q: How long does a custom order take?
faqs.a: Depending on the product and material selection, lead times typically run 8–14 weeks; major custom projects will have a dedicated timeline communicated by our team.

faqs.q: Do your products come with a warranty?
faqs.a: All MAAN furniture carries a five-year structural warranty, with separate care guidance and warranty terms for fabric and leather.

faqs.q: Can I order fabric or timber-finish samples on their own?
faqs.a: Yes — we offer a sample request service so you can compare materials against your space before placing an order.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MAAN respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through this website, how we use and store it, and the rights you may exercise.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you submit the contact form we collect the name, email address, phone number (optional), enquiry topic and message you provide.
When you subscribe to the newsletter we collect your email address only.
All of this is given voluntarily. Without it we cannot answer your enquiry or send you the newsletter.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: Contact form submissions are used solely to answer your enquiry and to follow up on product advice and related service.
Newsletter addresses are used solely to send new releases and brand news.
We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data, and we do not use it for purposes you would not expect.

sections.heading: Where your data is held
body: Form submissions are stored in a Google Sheet. That service is provided by Google LLC and the data may reside on servers outside Taiwan.
This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., whose server logs may include your IP address and browser information for operational and security purposes.
This website uses no Google Analytics and no third-party tracking or advertising scripts.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: This website sets a single necessary cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers whether you are reading the Chinese or English version.
It contains no identifying information and is not used to track your browsing. You may clear it in your browser at any time; the only effect is that your language preference is forgotten.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Contact form submissions are kept for two years from the date of submission, so that we can handle follow-up service and warranty matters, and are deleted thereafter.
Newsletter addresses are kept until you unsubscribe.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act you may request to review, obtain a copy of, supplement, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you, or ask us to stop collecting, processing or using it.
To exercise these rights, please contact us through the form on this website, stating your request. We will respond within thirty days of receipt.

sections.heading: Security
body: The entire site is served over HTTPS. Form data is encrypted in transit and access to the stored data is limited to authorised accounts.
No transmission over the internet can be guaranteed absolutely secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your data.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: Any revision will be published on this page with an updated date. Please check back from time to time.
